boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Marquette ceremonies, service practices and recurring campus rituals.

cards.title: New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Alumni Memorial Union · entering class welcome
cards.notes: Attend the entering-class gathering, where Marquette formally welcomes new students and introduces several campus rituals.
cards.evidence_claim: Marquette identifies New Student Convocation as an important tradition begun in 1994 and the first time the entering class gathers as a group.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of new-student programming; confirm the current program details with New Student and Family Programs.

cards.title: Meet the Honor Pledge
cards.subtitle: New Student Convocation · academic-community ritual
cards.notes: Listen for the Honor Pledge during Convocation and use the moment to understand one of the traditions introduced to newcomers.
cards.short_summary: The pledge is formally introduced with the incoming class.
cards.evidence_claim: Marquette’s Convocation page lists the Honor Pledge among the key university traditions introduced during New Student Convocation.
cards.access_notes: Presented within New Student Convocation; participation details are set by the program.

cards.title: Mission the Incoming Class
cards.subtitle: New Student Convocation · class welcome ritual
cards.notes: Notice the Missioning of the incoming class at Convocation, a named ritual that marks students’ entrance into the university community.
cards.short_summary: A formal ritual for the new class’s entry into Marquette.
cards.evidence_claim: Marquette’s Convocation page names the Missioning of the incoming class as a key university tradition introduced at the ceremony.
cards.access_notes: Presented within New Student Convocation; check the current Convocation program for timing.

cards.title: Learn the University Fight Song
cards.subtitle: New Student Convocation · shared school-spirit ritual
cards.notes: Learn the University Fight Song when it is introduced at Convocation, then recognize it at future Marquette community gatherings.
cards.short_summary: The fight song is one of Convocation’s named tradition introductions.
cards.evidence_claim: Marquette lists the University Fight Song among the key university traditions introduced at New Student Convocation.
cards.access_notes: Introduced during New Student Convocation; subsequent appearances vary by event.

cards.title: Start the Year at Mass of the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Church of the Gesu · academic-year gathering
cards.notes: Join the university-wide Mass and follow the gathering with the listed community picnic when the annual program is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A Jesuit academic tradition that opens the year in shared reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Marquette describes its Mass of the Holy Spirit as part of a Jesuit academic tradition dating to 1548; its 2026 gathering is scheduled at the Church of the Gesu.
cards.access_notes: The university lists the 2026 Mass for Aug. 30 at 6 p.m.; all are welcome. Confirm future dates before attending.

cards.entity_name: Tuesday Night Mass at St. Joan of Arc Chapel
cards.title: Tuesday Night Mass in the Chapel
cards.subtitle: St. Joan of Arc Chapel · student-led weekly Mass
cards.notes: Visit the historic chapel for the student-led Tuesday-night Mass, a Marquette tradition documented in the university’s Commencement Series.
cards.short_summary: A student-led Mass tradition in Marquette’s historic chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Marquette Today calls Tuesday night Mass at St. Joan of Arc Chapel a classic Marquette tradition and describes it as student-led.
cards.source_title: 2026 Commencement Series: Chance meeting leads to student receiving three sacraments just before graduation
cards.access_notes: Campus Ministry schedules student Masses; verify the current time and chapel access before going.

cards.title: Have Soup with Substance
cards.subtitle: Alumni Memorial Union · Wednesday social-justice conversation
cards.notes: Bring your attention to a social-justice issue over soup and bread at this longstanding Wednesday-noon Campus Ministry tradition.
cards.short_summary: A weekly simple meal paired with discussion and a presentation.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Ministry calls Soup with Substance a longstanding tradition held every Wednesday at noon in the Alumni Memorial Union, with soup, bread and social-justice conversation.
cards.access_notes: Listed for Wednesdays at noon in the Alumni Memorial Union; confirm dates and availability with Campus Ministry.

cards.title: Join the Midnight Run
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry · weekly Milwaukee service
cards.notes: Sign up with a service site and return weekly with your team to support meal programs, pantries, shelters and other partners.
cards.short_summary: A student-organized weekly service practice dating to 1988.
cards.evidence_claim: Marquette says Midnight Run began as a student response to community need in 1988 and sends weekly volunteers to Milwaukee service sites.
cards.access_notes: Participation requires signing up through Campus Ministry; service-site schedules and requirements vary.

cards.title: Take Part in Community Day of Service
cards.subtitle: Milwaukee partner agencies · annual service day
cards.notes: Register with a volunteer team for the spring service day and work alongside local agencies in intentional community engagement.
cards.short_summary: Marquette’s largest and longest-running day of service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arrupe Center identifies Marquette Community Day of Service, formerly Hunger Clean-Up, as the university’s largest and longest-running day of service.
cards.access_notes: Held annually; registration, partner locations and transportation details are announced for each year’s program.

cards.title: Gather for the Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: Westowne Square · annual December ceremony
cards.notes: Gather in Westowne Square for carols, remarks and the lighting of Marquette’s permanent annual Christmas tree.
cards.short_summary: A campus December ceremony with the Pep Band and All-Campus Choir.
cards.evidence_claim: Marquette reports that its annual Christmas tree lighting returned to Westowne Square in 2025, with carols, presidential remarks and a tree blessing.
cards.source_title: Marquette community gathers for annual Christmas tree lighting
cards.access_notes: An annual early-December event; watch Marquette Today for the current date and location.
